works.body:
Hello, sorry to trouble you.. I truly admire your art style, and I would like to kindly ask whether you would be interested in a commission to draw these two characters.
●Blond character: A very forward, clingy puppy-type who loves doting on his partner. He can be a bit annoying at times due to being overly attached. He is constantly thinking about marrying the black-haired character.

Black-haired character: A straightforward, dog-type character. Often confused about the world and especially about the blond character, but generally quite tolerant and indulgent.

●Relationship: They are a stable couple. Although it may seem like one-sided devotion, they genuinely love each other and share sweet, affectionate moments. 

●Interaction: Warm and cute vibes—kissing on the bed / holding hands in matching outfits, etc. 

Thank you very much for taking the time to read my request. If the proposed budget is not sufficient, please let me send another request

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1f7svOPoRjaLyfnRx_Rzvu-KXgzEp5TGb
